title: Red bar for E10-P7-01: a re-serializing embedding changes the inner verdict
scenario: Embedding the inner as parsed JSON and re-emitting it with JCS turns L-07 (re-indented, JSON_NONCANONICAL) into a canonical, VALID_STRICT bundle: the verdict changed. The vector harness must detect this.
choices: The model's red needs two canonicalization versions; V1 has one. The V1 red bar is a control on the harness/embedding, not on the verifier.

subcases.construction: the inner as embedded: conformance L-07 bytes
subcases.T_derivation: T = nTime(h*) of the fixture's own receipt proof and headers (a_sig and receipt_anchor as stamped; rows 11.1-11.4 pass); U = 7200 + max nTime(h*..h*+5) (A10.1.1)

subcases.construction: the red bar: L-07 parsed and re-emitted as JCS (what a re-serializing embedding harness hands back), verified with L-07's trust configuration
subcases.T_derivation: T = nTime(h*) of the fixture's own receipt proof and headers (a_sig and receipt_anchor as stamped; rows 11.1-11.4 pass); U = 7200 + max nTime(h*..h*+5) (A10.1.1)
subcases.note: This expected value is the WRONG inner verdict the red bar must produce: re-serialization turned INVALID / JSON_NONCANONICAL into VALID_STRICT. The harness passes the red bar when the two subcases' verdicts differ.
